text: 你试着开一扇门，发现门锁着。你沿着一排房子逐一查看，重复尝试好几次，发现它们都同样锁得严严实实。
你无功而返，决定回旅馆整理思绪。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 149
text: You try a door and find it locked. You move down the line of buildings and repeat this process several times. They are all similarly secured.
Defeated, you decide to head back to the hotel to gather your thoughts.
